title: Subagents
line: Give a child agent a small task and bring its answer back.

beats.caption: You enable subagents for this session.
The parent gives the scout a focused question.
The widget shows the scout’s work in progress.
beats.label: pi-subagents

beats.caption: The scout’s answer returns to the parent.

takeaway.title: Give the child a complete task
takeaway.line: It starts with its own context, so include what it needs.

notes: The scout and parent both use the local scripted model. No external model is called.

title.text: You can hand a small question to another agent when a separate piece of work needs attention.

scene.text: After you enable subagents, the parent starts a scout with one focused task. The widget shows it running. Its answer then comes back to the parent session.

takeaway.text: Give the child the whole question and the scope. It starts with its own context.
